subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: A cluster of commentary/overlay display, driver-data-table, and session-event commentary machinery: an overlay text slot manager with a vtable-dispatched render sink, a per-driver driver-data table (5-dword stride) with mode-dependent score gating, a per-driver AI HUD display-data reset path, and a family of race-commentary event emitters that build an 8-field event entry and append it to the shared session event table at flt_5EA618. Most owners are UNKNOWN at the function-IR level, so class groupings here are DERIVED/GUESS proposals over a shared guard pattern (dword_7D0308 race-active, flt_7CF3C8 track condition) rather than confirmed identities.

summary: Proposal for the generic_runtime_objects slice of Wave 3. The twenty functions cluster into: (1) a CommentaryOverlayDisplay object (0x4184B0 init, 0x4186F0 per-tick display timer, 0x4189F0 slot-table search-and-reset, 0x418A20 boolean-OR predicate) that owns a 20-entry 8-DWORD slot table at this+0x864, a pending/last-timestamp/active-id display state block at this+0xAE4..0xAEC, an init flag and overlay object at this+0xAF0/0xAF4, and renders through the overlay object's vtable slots +4/+8/+0x18; (2) a DriverTableEntryManager (0x418B70 indexed lookup, 0x418B90 mode-dependent score threshold gate) over the global 5-dword-stride driver table dword_5BF9A0, both serving InsertDriverTableEntry 0x418560; (3) an AIHUDDisplayData reset path (0x418E50) that reinitializes 104 per-driver display entries and hands off to AITargetDriverSelection; and (4) a RaceCommentaryEventEmitter family (0x419C50, 0x41A4A0, 0x41A6B0, 0x41A720, 0x41A940, 0x41AC50, 0x41AFD0, 0x41B190, 0x41B200, 0x41B970, 0x41B980, 0x41C090) that shares one tail: StructInitWithSentinelValues into an 8-field entry, DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion with the chosen event/message code, and InsertDriverTableEntry into flt_5EA618. One function, 0x41AD80 (OvertakingEventTracker), is DERIVED as a member of the CollisionDetectionSystem based on its single caller 0x4EA970, though it emits through the same event table. Field evidence on the vehicle-read offsets +0x39FC/+0x4060/+0x4064/+0x4070/+0x4894/+0x489C is packet-listed with base 'this' but the raw reads are on the a1 vehicle pointer; that base equivalence is inferred, not proven.

function_roles.role: Owner/initializer of the overlay display object: ShortArrayInit zeroes the leading short array, a do-while loop fills sub-structs from this+0x864 with sentinel defaults advancing 32 bytes per iteration, fields this+0xAF0 and this+0xAF4 are zeroed, EmptyStub_0170 runs, and BufferInitWith10fDefaults fills the trailing buffer region; returns this.

Per-tick text-overlay display timer: guarded by race-active dword_7D0308, track condition flt_7CF3C8 and the init flag at this+0xAF0, it steps the overlay object at this+0xAF4 via its vtable slot +0x18, manages the pending flag/last-display timestamp/active-id block (this+0xAE4/0xAE8/0xAEC), compacts the slot array, renders the active slot through the overlay object's vtable slot +4 once its per-slot threshold has elapsed, then resets the active slot and compacts again.

Linear scan of the 20-entry slot table at this+0x864 (8-DWORD stride, first DWORD per entry is an ID); every entry whose ID equals a2 is reset via StructInitWithSentinelValues; returns 1 if any entry matched else 0.

Boolean OR of two member checks on the same object: evaluates ArraySearchReturningIndex (0x4189F0) first and short-circuits on a nonzero byte result, otherwise evaluates StateCheckedVirtualDispatch (0x4189B0); used by the penalty path with the shared event table object as the receiver.
Indexed lookup into the global driver data table: returns dword_5BF9A0[5 * a1] when a1 is not the -1 sentinel, otherwise returns a1 unchanged; helper for InsertDriverTableEntry.

Mode-dependent score threshold gate: dispatches on global dword_7D0308 through jump table jpt_418B9D (0x418BFC) into mode 0 (==0x7FFFFFFF), mode 1 (>=70), mode 2 (>=40), mode 3 (>0) over dword_5BF9A0[5*a1]; any other mode keeps the default result 1.

Resets per-driver AI HUD display data for all 104 driver slots: writes the -1 driver-ID sentinel, a 0x7FFFFFFF maximum sentinel, zeroed base/timer/flag fields and a -1.0f float sentinel per entry, then calls AITargetDriverSelection for the initial AI target and zeroes three global tracking counters. Gated on race-active dword_7D0308 and non-zero flt_7CF3C8.

Per-driver race-finish commentary generator: guarded by race-active/track-condition state, maps the current track name (compared against 17 track-name strings) to a track-specific commentary ID for the player (default 167, else 158), emits generic 261/260 IDs for AI positions 1 and 2-5, and in championship mode 4 emits a close-race/leader-gap commentary ID 159 when the standings head's time exceeds best-lap plus ten times the position gap.

Display-message helper that emits fixed session event message ID 284: fills a local record via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and inserts it into the session event table at flt_5EA618; gated on dword_7D0308 and flt_7CF3C8.

Display-message helper that emits fixed race message ID 275: guarded like its siblings, it additionally invokes the vtable slot +12 method on the sound/system pointer dword_5EB10C and resets the shared buffer flt_5EA618 to 10.0f defaults before the lookup-and-insert tail.

Penalty/incident event handler: compares the driver ID at vehicle+0x4894 against the player vehicle at dword_7C54E8+0x4894; the player path maps penalty name strings (aSpeedingInPitl/aCutTrack/aJumpedStart/aIgnoredBlueFla) to event codes 153/151/155/154 and fires BooleanOROfTwoChecks for flags 123/124/125, while the AI path maps the same names to 256/253/254/252 (suppressed when race phase dword_7C56A8 == 8); both paths build an 8-field entry and insert it into flt_5EA618.

Ignored-stop-go-penalty commentary emitter: when the player vehicle (dword_7C54E8) equals the a1 vehicle and a2 matches aIgnoredStopGoP sets event code 149, else (AI path, race phase != 8) sets code 243; both paths run the shared sentinel-init, lookup-and-time-conversion, insert-into-flt_5EA618 tail.

Gear-based event dispatch for AI vehicles during championship weekend (session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, race phase != 8): event type a2 selects the code, 0 -> 208 (generic), 2 -> gear-specific 211-217 from the current gear at this+0x39FC via jump table jpt_41ACE9 (0x41AD60), 3 -> 220 (retirement); builds and appends the entry for vehicles that are neither the player vehicle nor finished.

Per-frame overtaking/passing event tracker invoked from the collision detection system: accepts an overtake when session time dbl_8AFEA0 is more than 2.0 seconds past the last recorded event for both drivers and the passed distance exceeds 1250.0; records time/distance/opponent per driver, emits event 114/115 when the player driver is involved, else 225/226 gated on a weather-noise table lookup, and appends the record to flt_5EA618.

Repair/service event commentary emitter: when the driver id at dword_7C54E8+0x4894 equals a1+0x4894 maps part index a2 (0-5) onto player event codes 106/107/109/110/108/111 via jump table jpt_41B028 (0x41B154); otherwise (race phase dword_7C56A8 != 8) maps onto AI codes 221/222/223 via jpt_41B0D4 (0x41B16C); both paths insert a sentinel-initialized entry into flt_5EA618.

Teammate audio event emitter: when the team/constructor field at player vehicle dword_7C54E8+0x4894 matches the AI entrant a1+0x4894, emits message ID 77 through the lookup-and-insert tail into flt_5EA618; called by sub_49B9A0.
Display-message helper that emits fixed session event message ID 74 through the shared driver-data table; guarded by dword_7D0308 and flt_7CF3C8, uses the standard lookup-and-insert tail.
Parameterless wrapper that declares a local 8-dword stack buffer, forwards it to StructInitWithSentinelValues and returns that call's result unchanged; no event-table interaction.

Team-name display-ID lookup: matches the team-name string at a1+252 against 44 season 1999-2002 team name constants via sub_566810, selecting display IDs 293-336, then runs the standard lookup-and-insert tail into the UI driver table at flt_5EA618; part of the UI team display system, called from UIRenderUpdateChain.
Display-message helper emitting fixed message code 514 through the shared driver-data table; guarded by dword_7D0308 and flt_7CF3C8, standard lookup-and-insert tail; sole static caller sub_40DE60.

classes.name: CommentaryOverlayDisplay
classes.responsibility: Text-overlay/commentary display controller. Owns a 20-entry 8-DWORD slot table at this+0x864 (each entry's first DWORD is an ID), a display-state block (pending flag, last-display timestamp, active overlay id) at this+0xAE4..0xAEC, an init flag at this+0xAF0 and an overlay object pointer at this+0xAF4 whose vtable exposes a per-tick update slot (+0x18), a render slot (+4) and a ready/busy query slot (+8). Initializes the object and buffer regions, drives the timed display per tick, and resets slots by ID. A boolean-OR predicate over the slot search and a state-check virtual dispatch is grouped here with low confidence because 0x418A20 is invoked with the shared event-table object as its receiver.

classes.name: DriverTableEntryManager
classes.responsibility: Access and gating logic over the global per-driver driver data table dword_5BF9A0 (5-DWORD stride per driver, with -1 and 0x7FFFFFFF sentinels). Provides indexed element lookup (helper for InsertDriverTableEntry) and a mode-dependent score threshold predicate whose comparison semantics are selected by global dword_7D0308 (modes 0..3).

classes.name: AIHUDDisplayData
classes.responsibility: Per-driver AI HUD display data container. Holds 104 per-driver display entries beginning at this+0x350 plus per-driver sentinel/counter/flag fields (this+0x4FC, 0x69C, 0x83C) and three global tracking counters (this+0x4F0/0x4F4/0x4F8); a reset path reinitializes every entry and hands the initial AI target selection to AITargetDriverSelection.

classes.name: RaceCommentaryEventEmitter
classes.responsibility: Family of race-commentary / session-event emitters that share one tail: initialize an 8-field event entry with StructInitWithSentinelValues (0x4144D0), populate it via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion (0x4144F0) with a literal event/message code and sentinel arguments (-1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0), and append it to the shared session event table flt_5EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry (0x418560). Includes finish commentary (per-driver race-finish, close-race gap), penalty/stop-go incident reporting, gear/retirement events, repair/service events, teammate audio, and fixed display messages (74, 77, 275, 284, 514) plus a team-name display-ID lookup. Vehicle read-only context (gear, finishing position, finish state, penalty count, driver id, related-driver id) is read off the a1 vehicle pointer and packet-listed with base 'this'.

classes.name: CollisionDetectionSystem
classes.responsibility: Collision detection system entry point for a per-frame overtaking/passing tracker. 0x41AD80 is DERIVED as a member on the strength of its single caller 0x4EA970; it accepts passing events (session-time cooldown of 2.0 seconds, distance threshold 1250.0), records per-driver event state, and emits player-involved (114/115) or AI (225/226, weather-noise gated) overtake events through the shared session event table.

transitions.condition: pending flag at this+0xAE4 set while the overlay object is not busy (vfunc+8 returns 0); active overlay id reset to -1
active slot present (this+0x864 != -1), object ready, and elapsed time since per-slot timestamp passes the per-slot threshold; render via vfunc+4
after successful render the active slot is reset to sentinels via StructInitWithSentinelValues and the slot array is compacted
compaction completes; pending flag cleared and display cycle restarts on the next eligible slot
any other mode value: result stays the initial 1
driver id at vehicle+0x4894 equals player vehicle (dword_7C54E8)+0x4894
driver id mismatch; AI path additionally suppressed when race phase dword_7C56A8 == 8
penalty string null or not mapped (codes 153/151/155/154)
penalty string null, race phase == 8, or name not mapped (codes 256/253/254/252)
mapped player code selected; ignored-blue-flag path fires BooleanOROfTwoChecks for flags 123/124/125
entry built and inserted into flt_5EA618

interfaces.name: IOverlayRenderSink
interfaces.purpose: Contract of the overlay object at this+0xAF4 consumed by the display loop: a per-tick update slot at vtable +0x18, a render slot at +4 invoked as (texts, count, 0), and a ready/busy query slot at +8 where a zero result means the object is ready. The concrete implementation is not among this packet's functions, so the functions list is empty.

interfaces.name: IDriverEventTable
interfaces.purpose: Contract for constructing and appending commentary/event entries to the shared session event table (flt_5EA618): an entry is a sentinel-initialized 8-field struct (StructInitWithSentinelValues 0x4144D0), populated by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion (0x4144F0) with a message/event code plus sentinel arguments (-1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0), and appended by InsertDriverTableEntry (0x418560). Implemented by the RaceCommentaryEventEmitter family; the callees themselves are outside this packet.

compatibility_contracts.name: RaceActivityGateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Every commentary/overlay emitter is gated by two globals: dword_7D0308 must be nonzero (race-active/session-active) and flt_7CF3C8 must be nonzero (track-condition state, compared against the ~0.0f constant flt_59E440 in several bodies). A replacement must preserve this gate so events are only emitted during an active session.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverEventTableContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Session event/commentary entries are 8-field structs initialized with sentinel values by StructInitWithSentinelValues (0x4144D0), populated by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion (0x4144F0) with a literal event/message code, a driver/related-driver index where relevant, and the fixed sentinel arguments (-1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0), then appended to the shared table at flt_5EA618 via InsertDriverTableEntry (0x418560).

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerVehicleIdContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The player vehicle is the pointer in global dword_7C54E8. Commentary emitters distinguish player vs AI paths by comparing the driver/team identifier at +0x4894 of the entrant vehicle against the same offset of the player vehicle, and pass +0x489C as the related-driver/context index to the event lookup. The base equivalence between the packet's 'this' and the a1 vehicle pointer is inferred.

compatibility_contracts.name: RacePhaseGateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The race phase dword_7C56A8 == 8 suppresses AI-side commentary emission (penalty, stop-go, repair, overtake paths), and the session type dword_7C56A4 == 7 (championship weekend) gates the gear-specific event dispatch. A replacement should honor these values when deciding whether to emit AI commentary.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverDataTableStrideContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Global dword_5BF9A0 is a per-driver data table with a 5-DWORD record stride (indexed as dword_5BF9A0[5 * driver]) and uses -1 (absent index) and 0x7FFFFFFF (maximum sentinel) as sentinels; a sibling table dword_5BF9AC is indexed at a 5-element stride as flt_5BF9AC[5 * slot].

compatibility_contracts.name: ScoreThresholdModeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Global dword_7D0308 also selects score-threshold semantics in the driver-table gate: 0 tests dword_5BF9A0[5*a1] == 0x7FFFFFFF, 1 tests >= 70, 2 tests >= 40, 3 tests > 0; any other value passes by default.

compatibility_contracts.name: OverlayVtableContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The overlay object at this+0xAF4 exposes three vtable slots relied on by the display loop: +0x18 (per-tick update), +4 (render a prepared text array with a count and a 0 argument), and +8 (ready query where a zero return means ready).

compatibility_contracts.name: CommentaryMessageCodeContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Event and message codes are fixed literals: player event codes 106-111 (repair parts), 149/243 (ignored stop-go), 151/153/154/155 vs 252-256 (penalties), 158/167 and track-specific 160-177 and gap 159 (finish commentary), 208/211-217/220 (gear/retirement), 221-223 (AI repair), 114/115 vs 225/226 (overtakes), 261/260 (generic podium), 74/77/275/284/514 (fixed messages), and 293-336 (team display ids). Their in-game meaning is DERIVED from the code literals, not independently proven.

unresolved: flt_59E440 is packet-listed as a read global but never appears in the raw decompiled source of most functions; it is likely a zero-comparison float constant folded into the '!= 0.0' guards (only 0x41A720 shows it as a guard operand). Its role is unresolved.
flt_59E800 and flt_59E820 are packet-listed globals for 0x41AD80 with no appearance in the raw source; no operation could be grounded on them.
The loop termination in 0x4184B0 reads decompiler variables whose initialization is not visible in the packet; the sub-struct iteration count and sentinel semantics are unclear.

The owners of most functions are UNKNOWN at the function-IR level; class grouping (CommentaryOverlayDisplay, DriverTableEntryManager, AIHUDDisplayData, RaceCommentaryEventEmitter) is a DERIVED/GUESS proposal. The RaceCommentaryEventEmitter members may in fact be free functions in one commentary module rather than methods of a single class.

Field evidence on offsets +0x39FC, +0x4060, +0x4064, +0x4070, +0x4894, +0x489C is packet-listed with base 'this' while the raw reads are on the a1 vehicle pointer; the base equivalence is inferred from identical offsets, not proven.

flt_5EA618 is float-named in the raw source but is used as the object/table argument to BooleanOROfTwoChecks, DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and InsertDriverTableEntry; its true type and layout are unresolved.
0x418A20 (grouped in CommentaryOverlayDisplay) is invoked by penalty paths with flt_5EA618 as its receiver; whether the slot-search object and the event-table object share a class is unproven.
The vfunc+8 ready semantics (0 = ready) and the vfunc+4 render signature are inferred from call shape only.

Event/message code semantics (114/115 vs 225/226, which +18588 driver id is overtaker vs overtaken, and the meaning of 208/211-217/220 and 74/77/275/284/514) are inferred from literals and branch structure, not confirmed by a label.
Jump tables jpt_418B9D (0x418BFC), jpt_41ACE9 (0x41AD60), jpt_41B028 (0x41B154) and jpt_41B0D4 (0x41B16C) implement the mode/gear/part dispatches, but their layouts are not evidenced by the packet.
sub_566810 is used as a string comparison (track/team names) with an inferred 0-on-match contract; its exact signature is not confirmed.
The byte flag array at this+2524 (zeroed per loop iteration in 0x418E50) has no packet field reference; it is described in prose only and not represented as a class field.
The dword_7D0410 global is described as both ChampionshipMode and RaceMode; the exact semantics of the range checks (2..5, ==4) are not fully resolved.
Standings-node offsets +408 (dword best time) and +432 (byte finished flag) used by 0x419C50 are DERIVED from decompiler output, not independently confirmed.
0x41B980 is part of the UI team display system (caller 0x476D70) but shares the emitter tail; whether it is genuinely a commentary emitter or a UI path over the same table is unresolved.
0x41B970 is a parameterless wrapper that initializes a discarded local buffer; its purpose and integer return interpretation are unknown.
The exact meaning of the race phase dword_7C56A8 == 8 and session type dword_7C56A4 == 7 values is caller-context dependent and not defined by this packet.
Callers 0x42D7A0 (Game_Restart) for 0x418E50 and 0x4A0BA0 (RaceFinishHandler) for 0x419C50 are known only from call-graph evidence; their invocation context is not examined here.
